Write the texts for our new landing page for the bike-check service: a headline, three benefit blocks, an FAQ with at least six questions, and the button texts.
English and Spanish versions with the same meaning.
The price is 25 EUR per check and the report comes by e-mail within one day; do not promise anything else.
